title: Petal_Promenade_Clarinet_Main_R3

tempo_clock.note: Source phrase timing transplanted with each segment; the new fiesta continuation uses the same nominal pulse without the old final ritardando.

musical_changes: First four original opening bars retained; original bars 5-8 omitted from the opening.
Original B middle expanded from four to twelve bars: original B + new four-bar continuation + B reprise.
clarinet is the main melody instrument from bar 5 to the end; the old lead does not return loudly.
Original final four-bar melodic material retained but voiced by the middle instrument.
Original nominal tempo retained; no audio time stretching, backing-track splicing, or original RC audio used.
audio_engine: Same TimGM6mb and deterministic room/percussion chain as R2; no paid service.
midi_limit: GM MIDI does not embed sample bank, custom percussion, external shelf EQ, room impulse or stem/master gains. Use render_polished.py for the actual sound.
loop_status: Closed audition; not a seamless loop.
